_help.about: Copy this file to config/mongo-config.json (git-ignored) and edit mongourl. The app only reads mongourl (or uri); _help is ignored. The MONGODB_URI env var overrides this file.
_help.user: MongoDB user the app logs in as, e.g. test_user. Give it readWrite on <database> only.
_help.password: That user's password. URL-encode @ : / ? # % if the password contains them.
_help.host: MongoDB server address: 127.0.0.1 for local, or a LAN IP/hostname. Loopback shows a green 'Local' badge, anything else amber 'Custom host'.
_help.port: 27017 unless you mapped a different port.
_help.database: Database the app uses; the collection is always 'people'.
_help.authSource: Database the user was created in (the one you were in when you ran db.createUser). Usually the same as <database>; 'admin' if the user was created there.
_help.atlas: For Atlas use mongodb+srv://<user>:<password>@<cluster>.mongodb.net/<database> (no port; authSource defaults to admin).
